Withered bone

Type: Misc | Internal ID: WitheredBone | Source: Muddy scrap piles, ,, Sunken Crypts | Usage: Crafting, Summon, Bonemass | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

Introduction. Withered bones are items found in Muddy scrap piles in Sunken Crypts and in Chests in the Swamp biome.

Crafting. • Nimble Anklet

Summoning. A total of ten Withered bones are required to summon the third boss, Bonemass. See Forsaken Altars.
